comparison.objective: Reload a sprung long-arm stapler and staple two sheets; candidate transfers a guide block to a service jig.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests holding a sprung magazine, placing a staple strip, paper feeding, and press actuation. Candidate tests precise support mating and free-ball-preserving sliding.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires a correctly loaded stapler, sheets stapled and withdrawn, hands released/clear, and settled mechanisms. Candidate requires complete transfer with uninterrupted support and no lost rolling element.
comparison.reason: Spring-loaded tool reloading and fastening do not test a bearing carriage crossing between continuous race supports.
